mission_prompt: create a Research paper recent developments in fusion energy reactors and summarize the latest 2026 milestones.

units.task_name: Collect Recent Fusion Reactor Literature & News
units.description: Perform targeted web searches for peer‑reviewed articles, conference proceedings, press releases, and industry reports published between 2024–2026 that discuss advances in fusion energy reactors (tokamaks, stellarators, laser‑driven inertial confinement, etc.). Extract key data points such as reactor type, power output, net energy gain, plasma confinement improvements, materials breakthroughs, and any announced milestones. Store the extracted information in a structured tabular format for downstream analysis.

Using the dataset produced by t1, identify all milestones that occurred in 2026. For each milestone, summarize the technical achievement, its significance for fusion energy commercialization, and any quantitative performance metrics. Group milestones by reactor type or technology family to highlight trends.

units.task_name: Draft Research Paper Outline & Executive Summary
units.description: Compose a research‑paper style outline that incorporates the findings from t2. Include sections such as Abstract, Introduction, Recent Advances (2024–2026), 2026 Milestones Overview, Discussion of Technological Implications, Future Outlook, and References. Provide an executive summary paragraph that captures the essence of the latest progress in fusion energy reactors.
